With support for more than 100 languages, you can transcribe recordings in virtually any language you encounter. Good Tape handles it, with the same accuracy in every language. See all 100+ languages Recording app for iOS and Android With the Good Tape recording app, you can also capture high-quality audio directly from your phone. Designed for iOS and Android, the app lets you record interviews, lectures, or meetings, syncs the recording with your Good Tape account and transcribes automatically. Never upload a file again. Just hit record. We’ve got the rest. Download for iOS or Android below today. *Good Tape still accepts all file formats. Get the recorder app Editing: Intuitive transcript editor No more clunky tools or endless scrolling. Good Tape’s editor is designed to be intuitive, fast, and accurate. Clean up transcripts, correct minor errors, and highlight key passages effortlessly. Whether you’re polishing an interview for publication or preparing notes for court, the editor helps you finish your work faster without distraction. Speaker labels: Clarity in conversations Speaker Labels show you who said what. Once you can see who said what, you can assign the names. Labels sit at the core of a usable transcript. If they are wrong, you re-listen to the whole thing. Speaker labels come with every transcription, at no extra cost and with nothing to switch on. See how speaker labels work AI summaries: Insights and overview Going through a full transcript can take as long as replaying the recording itself. It’s slow, exhausting, and rarely what you actually need. That’s why we built AI summaries. With one click, Good Tape turns your transcript into a clean overview of key points, themes, and insights. So instead of spending hours reading, you can understand the story in minutes. See a summary example See pricing Projects: Organize your tapes with ease Transcripts pile up quickly. That’s why Good Tape includes Projects, an easy way to group your recordings and transcripts into folders. Keep projects organized by topic, client, or date, so you never waste time searching for the file you need. Projects give you a clean workspace, especially when you’re managing dozens of ongoing projects. See how projects work Audio playback: Follow every word you hear Every transcript is linked to its audio source, making it easy to reference the original recording. Simply click on a word in the text, and playback begins from that exact moment (with time codes if needed). Whether you’re double-checking a quote for an article or verifying an interview response, playback keeps you connected to the source without endless rewinds. See playback in action Bulk uploads: Save hours on large projects When you have dozens of recordings to get through, upload them all in one go. Bulk uploads let you process multiple files in a single session, cutting down time spent managing files and freeing you to focus on analysis. It’s an essential feature for researchers, media teams , and organizations working with high volumes of audio or video. See how bulk upload works Export subtitles: Make content accessible Turn your transcripts into subtitles in just a few clicks. Whether you’re producing podcasts, webinars, films, or lectures, exporting subtitles makes your content accessible to wider audiences and improves discoverability. With Good Tape, you can generate .srt or .vtt files instantly, ready for upload to YouTube, Vimeo, or your own platform. Export .srt and .vtt Teams: sharing and collaboration Sometimes you need to share a transcript with a colleague or client, but you don’t want multiple people editing the same file simultaneously. Good Tape’s Team Sharing option makes it simple: share the file, give access, and let others review the content  while you stay in control of the transcript. See team sharing Notes: Highlight what’s extra important With Notes, you can highlight any word, phrase, or sentence in the transcript and add your thoughts instantly. Just select the text and click “Add Note.” Your comment is pinned directly to that exact moment in the conversation, so it stays connected to what was said not buried between speakers or lost in a long thread. See how notes work Good Tape MCP: Connect your transcripts Good Tape already turns your recordings into text. Now you can go from recording to done in minutes. Think of the MCP as a magic door between Good Tape and your AI tool of choice: We built the door, and you decide whether to open it and what it can see. Once connected, the AI tools’ privacy, data residency, and training terms apply. Draft an article from your interview, pull action points from a long meeting, or hunt for quotes you half-remember. Whatever is next from you is only one prompt away. Connect Good Tape to your AI tool Trusted by professionals and teams 4.7/5 Google Reviews See
